# Editable literature evolution candidate: independent expectations

These expectations precede candidate construction. Input is the unchanged
`seven-papers.json` synthetic fixture. The output is an editable design candidate,
not a released template, installed capability, verified scientific evolution map
or human-approved layout. Existing paper analyses and Canvas files remain unchanged.

## Handwritten content inventory

The candidate retains exactly seven declared papers and eight contributions,
including the two distinct contributions of `paper-six`. They reuse their existing
paper identities; repeated appearances do not become new canonical paper units.

| Contribution | Novelty types | Placement | Structural parent |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task-seed` | 1 | main | none |
| `representation-change` | 2 | main | `task-seed` |
| `alternative-route` | 2 | branch | `representation-change` |
| `local-module` | 3 | local | `representation-change` |
| `pipeline-refinement` | 4 | local | `representation-change` |
| `mixed-introduction` | 3 | local | `representation-change` |
| `mixed-adaptation` | 3, 4 | local | `alternative-route` |
| `pending-contribution` | not classified | pending | none |

The six non-null parent pairs are the complete structural membership graph. Every
pair remains recoverable from the Canvas, including paths through explicitly
identified routing points. Main and branch positions contain only eligible type
1/2 contributions. Local type 3/4 contributions are visible without promotion to
the main structure; the pending contribution is visible without invented placement
or category. Do not hide it in a discarded-items note.

Both scientific relations remain complete:

1. `representation-extension`: `task-seed` to `representation-change`, kind
   `extends`.
2. `reverse-comparison`: `alternative-route` to `representation-change`, kind
   `comparison`. This reverse direction must not disappear or become a forward
   inheritance assertion.

All eight classification statements and all ten relation statements are retained
with their full text, basis and declared evidence. Each relation includes Change,
Reason, Benefit, Cost and Conditions. The second relation's cost remains explicitly
`not_reported`; the pending classification remains `unverified`. Missing evidence
must not be filled with invented claims, and unverified must not become not reported.
Preserve every supplied PDF evidence locator and its source-verification state.

## Editable, independently readable candidate

- Native JSON Canvas text nodes carry the overview, complete classification cards
  and complete relation cards on the same canvas. An image, SVG, HTML screenshot
  or flattened PDF is not an editable substitute.
- Use a compact vertical overview: main downward, branch alongside, local and
  pending clearly distinguished. Full detail cards remain on the same canvas,
  readable and associated with their contributions or relation endpoints.
- The overview is explicitly a **structural membership** view. A parent connector
  does not mean extends, priority, causality or experimental superiority. Scientific
  relations may remain entirely in their full cards; no requirement forces every
  scientific relation into a potentially crossing connector.
- Paper titles, declared relative note paths and the two-contribution reuse remain
  discoverable. A declared note path is not claimed to exist or open correctly.
  Do not create cross-Source ambiguous wikilinks or native file links that silently
  resolve those declarations against the candidate's containing Vault.
- Source locators use the declared stable Zotero identity and physical page number
  (`page_index + 1`), including the personal and group forms. No loopback URL or
  port identity appears. These synthetic reader links are not probed and must be
  labelled source not verified, not reader tested.
- English labels, source states and explanations remain consistent with this
  English fixture. Machine UUIDs and hashes do not replace readable titles or
  overwhelm cards; structured provenance may accompany the candidate separately.

## Geometry and appearance requirements

- All Canvas node IDs and edge IDs are unique in their respective collections;
  every edge endpoint names an existing node. Routing points are explicitly
  nonsemantic and do not count as papers, contributions or new science relations.
- Node interiors do not overlap. Text and source-link click areas fit inside their
  nodes without clipping; leave roughly one text line of additional usable space.
- Every displayed connector segment is horizontal or vertical. No diagonal or
  curved connector substitutes for a straight orthogonal route.
- Connectors do not pass through unrelated node interiors. They do not cross,
  touch or share an ambiguous segment away from an explicit shared endpoint or
  junction. A routing bend is not permission to conceal a crossing.
- Align peers and related cards consistently. Use readable whitespace rather than
  arbitrary long chains, tiny text, cropped statements or removed evidence to
  obtain compactness.
- The intended editor's effective text size is at least 18 px. Do not pretend a
  plain JSON Canvas file proves effective font size where the editor/theme owns
  that property; obtain a rendered observation later or retain that check pending.

Exact coordinates, colors, font-family choice, unnecessary fractional font sizes,
card counts and final carrier defaults are not fixed by this candidate test.
Meeting structural geometry checks does not establish beauty or human usability.

## Independent assessment and preservation

The later evaluator checks the handwritten inventory against the fixture and
candidate, not against a product validator's own generated expectations. Collapse
only explicitly declared routing paths when checking the six membership pairs;
never infer science relations from proximity, publication order or parent edges.
Check the eight full classification records and ten full tradeoff statements,
their basis/evidence and the reverse comparison independently of graph geometry.

Before and after candidate generation/checking, compare the original fixture and
any selected pre-existing Canvas bytes. No original file may change. Only the
explicitly chosen candidate artifacts may be created, with their state labelled
synthetic design candidate and automatic/human checks separated.

No checks have been executed by preparing this file. Editor rendering, editing,
effective font size, source-link behaviour and visual assessment remain pending;
the user must see the candidate and explicit assessment instructions before any
human-approved claim is made.
